fields.why: Percent positivity (an outcome per group) is ranked across three age groups (5–9, 1–4, 10–14 years); the shares of tests and cases by age are composition only.
Age is the only SPD with 3+ groups compared; countries and testing strategies are not SPDs, and key populations appear only in a recommendation.
No tests, CIs or ratios across age groups; values are only ranked.
